rubric_items.reason: Prior gaps closed: S-7 has API tests for the patient and doctor pages, and S-5 AC4 has API and web dashboard tests. Only the CO-6 server.ts start/stop wiring is still untested.

Assertions check status, history, actor, HTTP codes, badges and timer calls. Weak spots: the dashboard API test checks only the totals keys, not the counts it claims are unchanged, and the S-1 'one minute after 24h' check is really 61 minutes after.
Error paths are covered: past reschedule 400, cancel without reason 400, closed 409, unknown status 400, job failure logging. The exact 24h boundary and a one-minute-after case are not tested.
Vitest/Supertest, fixed clock, skipIf without a DB and jsdom web tests match the strategy. Test names still start with HMS-34 instead of the requirement ID.
No invented numbers. Pass results are left to checks.json, and coverage is reported as not measured, which matches the verifier's coverage skip.
